idempotency_keys_active_is_bound.name: idempotency_keys_active_is_bound
idempotency_keys_active_is_bound.value:
"idempotency_keys"."status" <> 'active' OR (
        "idempotency_keys"."method" IS NOT NULL
        AND "idempotency_keys"."route" IS NOT NULL
        AND "idempotency_keys"."request_fingerprint" IS NOT NULL
      )

idempotency_keys_expired_is_cleared.name: idempotency_keys_expired_is_cleared
idempotency_keys_expired_is_cleared.value:
"idempotency_keys"."status" <> 'expired' OR (
        "idempotency_keys"."actor_id" IS NULL
        AND "idempotency_keys"."method" IS NULL
        AND "idempotency_keys"."route" IS NULL
        AND "idempotency_keys"."request_fingerprint" IS NULL
        AND "idempotency_keys"."response_body" IS NULL
        AND "idempotency_keys"."response_etag" IS NULL
        AND "idempotency_keys"."response_location" IS NULL
        AND "idempotency_keys"."lease_owner" IS NULL
        AND "idempotency_keys"."lease_expires_at" IS NULL
      )

users_email_or_phone.name: users_email_or_phone
users_email_or_phone.value: "users"."email" IS NOT NULL OR "users"."phone" IS NOT NULL

event_experts_role_bounds.name: event_experts_role_bounds
event_experts_role_bounds.value: "event_experts"."role" IS NULL OR char_length("event_experts"."role") BETWEEN 1 AND 80

experts_family_name_bounds.name: experts_family_name_bounds
experts_family_name_bounds.value: "experts"."family_name" IS NULL OR char_length("experts"."family_name") BETWEEN 1 AND 80

experts_given_name_bounds.name: experts_given_name_bounds
experts_given_name_bounds.value: "experts"."given_name" IS NULL OR char_length("experts"."given_name") BETWEEN 1 AND 80

experts_patronymic_bounds.name: experts_patronymic_bounds
experts_patronymic_bounds.value: "experts"."patronymic" IS NULL OR char_length("experts"."patronymic") BETWEEN 1 AND 80

experts_credentials_bounds.name: experts_credentials_bounds
experts_credentials_bounds.value: "experts"."credentials" IS NULL OR char_length("experts"."credentials") BETWEEN 1 AND 500

experts_affiliation_bounds.name: experts_affiliation_bounds
experts_affiliation_bounds.value: "experts"."affiliation" IS NULL OR char_length("experts"."affiliation") BETWEEN 1 AND 240

experts_bio_bounds.name: experts_bio_bounds
experts_bio_bounds.value: "experts"."bio" IS NULL OR char_length("experts"."bio") BETWEEN 1 AND 4000

experts_structured_name_present_unless_r.name: experts_structured_name_present_unless_removed
experts_structured_name_present_unless_r.value: "experts"."content_removed_at" IS NOT NULL OR ("experts"."family_name" IS NOT NULL AND "experts"."given_name" IS NOT NULL)

experts_content_removed_shape.name: experts_content_removed_shape
experts_content_removed_shape.value:
"experts"."content_removed_at" IS NULL OR (
        "experts"."status" = 'retired'
        AND "experts"."deleted_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "experts"."family_name" IS NULL
        AND "experts"."given_name" IS NULL
        AND "experts"."patronymic" IS NULL
        AND "experts"."photo_ref" IS NULL
        AND "experts"."professional_role" IS NULL
        AND "experts"."credentials" IS NULL
        AND "experts"."affiliation" IS NULL
        AND "experts"."bio" IS NULL
      )

partners_website_url_bounds.name: partners_website_url_bounds
partners_website_url_bounds.value: "partners"."website_url" IS NULL OR char_length("partners"."website_url") BETWEEN 1 AND 2048

projects_description_bounds.name: projects_description_bounds
projects_description_bounds.value: "projects"."description" IS NULL OR char_length("projects"."description") BETWEEN 1 AND 2000

media_cleanup_jobs_terminal_is_cleared.name: media_cleanup_jobs_terminal_is_cleared
media_cleanup_jobs_terminal_is_cleared.value:
"media_cleanup_jobs"."status" <> 'expired' OR (
        "media_cleanup_jobs"."execution_state" = 'completed'
        AND "media_cleanup_jobs"."object_key" IS NULL
        AND "media_cleanup_jobs"."cdn_key" IS NULL
        AND "media_cleanup_jobs"."entity_id" IS NULL
        AND "media_cleanup_jobs"."lease_owner" IS NULL
        AND "media_cleanup_jobs"."lease_expires_at" IS NULL
        AND "media_cleanup_jobs"."last_error" IS NULL
        AND "media_cleanup_jobs"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL
      )

media_cleanup_jobs_active_has_locator.name: media_cleanup_jobs_active_has_locator
media_cleanup_jobs_active_has_locator.value: "media_cleanup_jobs"."status" <> 'active' OR ("media_cleanup_jobs"."object_key" IS NOT NULL AND "media_cleanup_jobs"."entity_id" IS NOT NULL)

speaker_migration_cutover_closed_require.name: speaker_migration_cutover_closed_requires_floor
speaker_migration_cutover_closed_require.value: "speaker_migration_cutover"."phase" <> 'source_closed' OR ("speaker_migration_cutover"."minimum_compatible_release_sha" IS NOT NULL AND "speaker_migration_cutover"."phase_advanced_at" IS NOT NULL)

speaker_migration_cutover_sha_shape.name: speaker_migration_cutover_sha_shape
speaker_migration_cutover_sha_shape.value:
("speaker_migration_cutover"."phase_aware_release_sha" IS NULL OR "speaker_migration_cutover"."phase_aware_release_sha" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{40}$')
          AND ("speaker_migration_cutover"."minimum_compatible_release_sha" IS NULL OR "speaker_migration_cutover"."minimum_compatible_release_sha" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{40}$')

speaker_migration_cutover_ordinals_posit.name: speaker_migration_cutover_ordinals_positive
speaker_migration_cutover_ordinals_posit.value:
("speaker_migration_cutover"."phase_aware_release_ordinal" IS NULL OR "speaker_migration_cutover"."phase_aware_release_ordinal" >= 1)
          AND ("speaker_migration_cutover"."minimum_compatible_release_ordinal" IS NULL OR "speaker_migration_cutover"."minimum_compatible_release_ordinal" >= 1)
